questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.

A. Only after the meeting ended did I realise the time.
B. Only after the meeting ended did I realise the time.
C. Only after the meeting ended did I realise the time.
D. Only after the meeting ended did I realise the time.
options: Only after the meeting ended was I able to leave the room.
Only after the meeting ended did I realise the time.
Only after the meeting ended did I realise the time.
Only after the meeting ended did I realise the time.
questions.answer: Only after the meeting ended did I realise the time.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail?

A. It was John who broke the window.
B. It was John who broke the window.
C. It was John who broke the window.
D. It was John who broke the window.
options: It was John who broke the window.
It was John that broke the window.
It was John which broke the window.
John it was that broke the window.
questions.answer: It was John who broke the window.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation.

A. If I were you, I would accept the offer.
B. If I was you, I would accept the offer.
C. If I had been you, I would accept the offer.
D. If I had been you, I would have accepted the offer.
options: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
If I was you, I would accept the offer.
If I had been you, I would accept the offer.
If I had been you, I would have accepted the offer.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would accept the offer.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses ellipsis to maintain grammatical parallelism?

A. She likes reading books, swimming in the sea, and hiking mountains.
B. She likes reading books, swimming in the sea, and hiking mountains.
C. She likes reading books, swimming in the sea, and hiking mountains.
D. She likes reading books, swimming in the sea, and hiking mountains.
options: She likes reading books, swimming in the sea, and hiking mountains.
She likes reading books, to swim in the sea, and hiking mountains.
She likes reading books, swimming in the sea, and to hike mountains.
She likes reading books, to swim in the sea, and to hike mountains.
questions.answer: She likes reading books, swimming in the sea, and hiking mountains.

questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses a formal register to express a condition.

A. In the event that you forget your password, you can reset it.
B. If you forget your password, you can reset it.
C. Should you forget your password, you can reset it.
D. Whenever you forget your password, you can reset it.
options: In the event that you forget your password, you can reset it.
If you forget your password, you can reset it.
Should you forget your password, you can reset it.
Whenever you forget your password, you can reset it.
questions.answer: In the event that you forget your password, you can reset it.
